name: shunge-ai-short-drama
description: An end-to-end AI short-drama director that turns a user story into a publishable vertical series: premise and canon, script breakdown, character and scene art, Doubao web generation, measured subtitles, post-production, story editing, captions, opening, transitions and archive.

displayDescription.en: Turns a raw story into a publishable vertical short drama: canon, script breakdown, character art, Doubao generation, measured subtitles, editing, captions, opening and transitions, all verified end to end.
displayDescription.zh: 独立承接AI短剧全流程：故事拆剧本、定妆出片、字幕实测、后期剪辑与片头过渡，一次交付可发布成片。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我这里有个故事，帮我拆成一部短剧并做到能发布。
defaultInitPrompt.en: I have a story. Break it into a short drama and take it to release-ready.

quickPrompts.en: I have a story. Break it into a short drama and take it to release-ready.
quickPrompts.zh: 我这里有个故事，帮我拆成一部短剧并做到能发布。

quickPrompts.en: Design the character and scene art and lock the series canon for me.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我做角色定妆和场景图，并把全剧设定写成唯一事实源。

quickPrompts.en: Finish the post-production: measured subtitles, opening, day transitions and final cut.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我完成后期：字幕实测、加片头、插入换日过渡并拼成成片。
